name: University College Absalon
about: Absalon is a university college on Zealand. Its English-taught engineering degrees are based at the 2021 Kalundborg campus, in a small international study environment close to biotechnology and production companies. Biotechnology includes a company internship; Robot Systems starts in September 2027.
knownFor: Engineering projects and internships with Kalundborg industry

languageOfInstruction.note: Absalon says three of its programmes are taught fully or partly in English. Only the two engineering degrees in Kalundborg are fully in English.

sources.title: Absalon lists three programmes taught fully or partly in English: the Bachelor of Engineering in Biotechnology, the Bachelor of Engineering in Robot Systems, and the Professional Bachelor's Degree in Education.
Absalon states that the political agreement to reduce English-taught programmes does not affect its English-taught biotechnology BEng in Kalundborg.
Professionshøjskolen Absalon, formerly University College Sjælland, received positive institutional accreditation on 3 June 2021.
The full-degree hub lists Biotechnology, Robot Systems and Education as three programmes taught fully or partly in English.
The 2021 Campus Kalundborg has a small international study environment and lists Biotechnology and Robot Systems.

The Bachelor of Engineering in Biotechnology (Kalundborg) has a 15 March deadline for all applicants with an international exam, including the IB, interviews every quota 2 applicant, and charges no tuition to EU or EEA citizens.
sources.quote: Admission Interview : All quota 2 applicants must attend an admission interview to be for admission to the programme. [...] Foreign exams also include International Baccalaureate (IB), regardless of whether it has been taken in Denmark or completed in another country. [...] 15 March at 12.00 noon All quota 2 applicants All applicants with an international entry examination, including applicants holding an International Baccalaureate (IB) [...] Applicants who are citizens in an EU or EEA country have access to free higher education in Denmark and therefore do not need to pay tuition fee.

sources.title: The Bachelor of Engineering in Robot Systems is a new English-taught programme in Kalundborg, starting in September 2027.
sources.quote: The Bachelor of Engineering in Robot Systems at University College Absalon is an English-taught engineering degree [...] The programme starts in September 2027 and is taught in Kalundborg, Denmark [...] From September 2027, students will be able to study a Bachelor of Engineering in Robot Systems in Kalundborg. The Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science has approved University College Absalon's application to launch the new English-taught programme

sources.title: IB applicants apply through Optagelse by 15 March noon; EU summer finishers must declare completion and monitor nemStudie document requests.
sources.quote: IB is an international exam even when taken in Denmark. Apply by 15 March at noon. Required documentation is due then, with missing items subject to individual nemStudie deadlines. EU summer finishers should state this in the application. 5 July is the application deadline only for Danish-exam applicants.

sources.title: Biotechnology retains its subject prerequisites, quota 2 interview and 65/35 quota split; current English alternatives include the new TOEFL scale.
sources.quote: Mathematics A; Physics B or Geoscience A; Chemistry B or Biotechnology A; English B. Quota 2 interview assesses academic qualifications, English and motivation. Other criteria include exam results, work, courses and documented qualifications. TOEFL 4.5 (94 before 21 January 2026), IELTS 6.5 or Cambridge 180; tests no older than two years.

sources.title: Robot Systems now publishes a quota 1 GPA floor of 5.0 on the Danish scale and quota 2 interview ranking, with 65/35 places.
sources.quote: Quota 1 ranks by GPA, at least 5.0 Danish scale. Quota 2 ranks interview test scores; interviewing is optional when the quota 1 GPA requirement is met. Other assessment criteria name grades, work, relevant courses and documented qualifications. Required subjects remain Mathematics A, Physics B or Geoscience A, English B. English alternatives: TOEFL 4.5 (94 before 21 January 2026), IELTS 6.5, Cambridge 180, within two years.

sources.title: The engineering FAQ allows later exam evidence and describes the preliminary-results procedure; the programme-specific instructions still control individual requests.
sources.quote: Exam evidence may be documented by 5 July at noon. If completion is later but before 1 September, say so and attach preliminary results and expected-subject-hours verification before 5 July. IB exams are generally exempt from the subject-hours verification form. Offers arrive via nemStudie.

notes: Absalon was formerly University College Sjælland; the accreditation authority records positive institutional accreditation on 3 June 2021. Both English engineering degrees are taught in Kalundborg. The wider institution has other campuses.
Education in Vordingborg begins in English but is taught partly in Danish and requires Danish during the degree; it is outside this fully English degree list.

Apply through Optagelse.dk by 15 March at 12:00 noon CET, including an IB earned in Denmark. The published annual deadline is provisional for 2027. Monitor nemStudie for individual document requests and the reply deadline in the admission letter.

The engineering FAQ allows preliminary results and expected subject-hours evidence before 5 July noon when the final exam arrives later, before 1 September. The application pages specifically allow EU summer finishers to declare this. Same-year non-EU IB eligibility and an exact final-IB delivery deadline need confirmation.

EU/EEA citizens pay no tuition. Other applicants normally pay DKK 3,750 before assessment; it is non-refundable unless admitted, when it is credited to tuition. Current published full-programme tuition is DKK 500,302.58; the table is undated for 2027 and fees may change. From September 2026, tuition-paying students pay the first year in advance.

Both engineering degrees require English B. If the qualifying exam lacks that level, accepted tests are IELTS 6.5, TOEFL 4.5 (94 for tests before 21 January 2026), or Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 180; results must be no older than two years at the application deadline.

Robot Systems currently gives 65% of places to quota 1 (Danish GPA at least 5.0, ranked by GPA) and 35% to quota 2 (ranked interview scores). Biotechnology requires an interview from every quota 2 applicant. Meeting requirements does not guarantee a place.

Robot Systems puts its internship in semester five, while its fee table puts the low-fee semester in semester six. Confirm the payment schedule before budgeting. Absalon says it cannot offer scholarships.

Its English-taught engineering degrees are based at the 2021 Kalundborg campus, in a small international study environment close to biotechnology and production companies. Biotechnology includes a company internship; Robot Systems starts in September 2027.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is a diplomingeniør programme at a university college, which is a professionsbachelor programme: Absalon lists the programme on its Danish page as a professionsbachelor ("Professionsbachelor — Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi"). The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

sources.title: DP Course Results (formerly the IB Certificate) of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three subjects at HL, are a qualifying examination in Denmark on the same terms as a two-year hf without overbygning: they give access to erhvervsakademi- and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2, and to a university bachelor only after two successive raises of upper-secondary subject level, at least one to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag. Course Results under 18 points, or containing any subject at grade 1 or 2, are not a qualifying examination at all. A full IB Diploma of 24 points or more gives access to every higher education programme in Denmark.
sources.quote: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2. Ansøgere med et Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results på mindst 18 point og mindst karakteren 3 i alle fag kan derudover få adgang til en universitetsbacheloruddannelse gennem kvote 1 og 2 ved enten at supplere med enkeltfag efter samme regler som hf’erne eller tage deres IB-eksamen om for at få et IB Diploma – Retake.

Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is a diplomingeniør programme at a university college, which is a professionsbachelor programme: Absalon offers it as a diplomingeniør programme, the same professionsbachelor type as its Biotechnology BEng. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

sources.title: DP Course Results (formerly the IB Certificate) of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three subjects at HL, are a qualifying examination in Denmark on the same terms as a two-year hf without overbygning: they give access to erhvervsakademi- and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2, and to a university bachelor only after two successive raises of upper-secondary subject level, at least one to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag. Course Results under 18 points, or containing any subject at grade 1 or 2, are not a qualifying examination at all. A full IB Diploma of 24 points or more gives access to every higher education programme in Denmark.
sources.quote: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2. Ansøgere med et Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results på mindst 18 point og mindst karakteren 3 i alle fag kan derudover få adgang til en universitetsbacheloruddannelse gennem kvote 1 og 2 ved enten at supplere med enkeltfag efter samme regler som hf’erne eller tage deres IB-eksamen om for at få et IB Diploma – Retake.

[...] Foreign exams also include International Baccalaureate (IB), regardless of whether it has been taken in Denmark or completed in another country. [...] 15 March at 12.00 noon All quota 2 applicants All applicants with an international entry examination, including applicants holding an International Baccalaureate (IB) [...] Applicants who are citizens in an EU or EEA country have access to free higher education in Denmark and therefore do not need to pay tuition fee.

sources.title: IB applicants apply through Optagelse by 15 March noon; EU summer finishers must declare completion and monitor nemStudie document requests.
sources.quote: IB is an international exam even when taken in Denmark. Apply by 15 March at noon. Required documentation is due then, with missing items subject to individual nemStudie deadlines. EU summer finishers should state this in the application. 5 July is the application deadline only for Danish-exam applicants.

sources.title: The engineering FAQ allows later exam evidence and describes the preliminary-results procedure; the programme-specific instructions still control individual requests.
sources.quote: Exam evidence may be documented by 5 July at noon. If completion is later but before 1 September, say so and attach preliminary results and expected-subject-hours verification before 5 July. IB exams are generally exempt from the subject-hours verification form. Offers arrive via nemStudie.
